method: Independent exact rational coefficient reconstruction from the current explicit strategy, without importing archived solvers or audits.
parameter_domain: a>0, q>=a; the original unit-customer theorem restricts both to integers.
criterion: Each exact coefficient in this basis is nonnegative. Exhausting the finite 43-node strategy therefore proves all its ICs for every parameter in the domain, rather than extrapolating finitely many parameter samples.
scope: This checks one explicitly defined complete strategy symbolically in a,q. It does not enumerate all joint SPE, prove minimality, or establish the payoff-unique product theorem.
